title: Introducing view-only members in Basedash
summary: Invite anyone to Basedash as a view-only member: they can view, filter, and export what you share, but never edit it. Connect in Basedash for AI dashboards,…
body_markdown:
Today we’re launching **view-only members** in Basedash. View-only is a new role for people who should see your data but never change it: the board, a client, or a whole sales or finance team.


Most people who look at your dashboards never need to edit them. Until now, inviting them to Basedash meant handing over a full seat, and one stray rename or delete could change a dashboard for everyone. Now you can give them access to the numbers without the edit button.


## Pick View-only when you invite


View-only sits next to Admin and Member wherever you choose a role:


- The **invite dialog** , when you add people to your organization
- The role menu in **member settings** , for people who are already in it
- The **public API** , so you can set roles from your own systems
- An **embed sign-in token** , by passing View-only as the role


## View, filter, export. Never edit


View-only members can open the dashboards, saved charts, automations, and chat history you share with them. They can:


- Run saved charts
- Use dashboard filters and drilldowns
- Export results


They can’t create or edit anything, run automations, or chat. That makes it a safe way to give stakeholders, clients, or a whole department access to your data.


## A ceiling on sharing


View-only works on top of the sharing you already have. Anything a view-only member could edit or manage becomes view access, so even a **Full access** grant behaves like **Can view** . Anything they couldn’t see before stays hidden.


Their grants are kept, too. Promote someone back to Member and they get exactly the access they had.


## Share now works inside full app embeds


Separately, the Share button is now available on dashboards, folders, and chats in full app embeds. Embedded users can see who has access, and people with full access can change it, all without leaving your app. Anything that would send someone outside the embed, like Copy link or a public link, stays hidden.


## Getting started


View-only members are in Basedash today.


1. [Sign up for Basedash](https://charts.basedash.com/signup) or log in
2. Invite someone to your organization, or open member settings for someone already in it
3. Choose **View-only** as their role
4. Share the dashboards, charts, automations, and chats they should see


For more on sharing and embeds, see the[Dashboards](https://www.basedash.com/features/dashboards) and[Embedding](https://www.basedash.com/features/embedding) feature pages.


**Share the numbers. Not the edit button.**
